title: Early access
changes: First public release of Suppuo — helpdesk and ticketing for Indonesian SMEs.
Hosted ticket form: customers submit support tickets without an account.
Shared agent inbox with statuses (open / pending / resolved / closed), priorities, and assignment.
Internal notes and canned replies for agents.
Requesters get email updates plus a private, tokenized status link.
Multi-workspace via Huudis SSO, REST API with Bearer auth, webhooks via outbox, and the @forjio/suppuo-cli.
Free during early access — paid plans via Plugipay come later.
